notes.title: Steam Deck Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Wish Project v3.0.0 changes:[/h3]

[list][*]Wish Project is now playable on Steam Deck and Linux.
[*]Improved frame rate consistency on modern hardware.
[*]Practice mode leaderboards on the stage select screen now properly refresh after a stage clear.
[*]Added support for windowed resolutions larger than 1920x1080.
[*]Resolution now properly scales with high DPI desktops.
[*]Graphics/resolution settings no longer sync to cloud.
[*]Fixed missing visual background effect at Stage 1 mid boss.
[*]Fixed missing visual background effect at Stage 2 mid boss.[/list]

[h3]Important Note: Cloud Saves[/h3]

[strike]Wish Project's cloud save data is currently Windows only. It will be switched to cross-platform on February 18th at 23:00 EST. On Steam, cloud save data is stored per-platform (with cross-platform being its own category) so the current Windows cloud save data will become inaccessible once the switch occurs. This will not be a problem if the saves are already downloaded on your PC: simply run the game again to upload them. However, [b]if Wish Project is not downloaded and you wish to keep your cloud save data, please make sure to run the game once before February 18th 23:00 EST[/b] to download your current cloud save data.[/strike]

Wish Project's cloud save data has been switched from Windows to cross-platform. If you are having trouble syncing your cloud save data, please manually download it from here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/account/remotestorageapp/?appid=367140]https://store.steampowered.com/account/remotestorageapp/?appid=367140[/url]

And then place those files into the game's save folder for your platform:
[list][*][b]Windows:[/b] %USERPROFILE%/Saved Games/Wish Project/
[*][b]Linux/Steam Deck:[/b] ~/.local/share/Wish Project/[/list]

[h3]Legacy Branch[/h3]

It has been many years since Wish Project was last updated. If for some reason the new patch does not work on your PC, but the previous version did, please opt into the legacy branch to continue using the previous version.

To opt into the legacy branch, right-click Wish Project in your steam library, choose Properties, select Betas on the left, and then select "legacy" from the dropdown menu.

notes.title: Cleanup Patch
notes.notes:
Wish Project v2.1.2 changes:
- Fixed a bug which caused the last 8 unlockables to sometimes not be rewarded properly. (If you have already fulfilled any of the unlock conditions but didn't get a reward, this patch will give it to you)
- Fixed a bug which caused certain boss bullets to sometimes remain active even after the boss was destroyed. (Note: If any replays recorded before v2.1.2 witnessed this bug, those replays may desync when viewed in v2.1.2)
- The replay menu now shows which version a replay was recorded in.
- Renaming a replay no longer updates the time of recording.
- Fixed some minor UI bugs when displaying long names.

Wish Project v2.1.1 changes:
- Fixed a minor UI bug when displaying online leaderboards.
